Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I tested the trial merge locally against `upstream/main` at `f3b0e195503466db86b0ff0b15dbf614153e1bb4`.
I checked the laws from that main revision. No GitHub runner ran.

**What looks good**

- The eight posts append explanations after the executable words. The complete line determines whether the comment fits.
- The wire post leaves machine-supplied EDM commands unexplained. The sinker post retains its separate emitter for these commands.
- The dialect tables cover Sinumerik units and offsets, plasma commands, and extended lathe offsets.
- Heidenhain and Sodick retain named refusals. The decision file explains the limits and the alternatives.
- I read all 335 new lines in the eight goldens. No existing golden changed. The tests recover the plain output exactly.
- There are no UI changes, dependency changes, or importer changes. UI screenshots and the extra importer suites do not apply.

**Results from this review**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with upstream main | Clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 140 steps passed; 1,094 tests passed; one heavy test ignored in debug |
| Selected post and app test builds | Passed as part of quick |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| Worktree after mutation restoration | Clean |

**Extra suites run**

I searched the test sources for readers of `golden/explain`. I ran both reader suites again after quick:

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --test explain_remaining --test explain_fanuc_family` | `explain_remaining`: 14 passed; `explain_fanuc_family`: 10 passed |

No STEP fixture or import code changed.

**Mutations run by this review**

| Mutation | Red result | Result after restoration |
|---|---|---|
| Remove the Sinumerik line-length guard | `sinumerik_explain_golden_preserves_program` failed at `explain_remaining.rs:61` on the overlong preamble | Passed |
| Remove the wire machine-code bypass | `wire_explain_never_assigns_milling_meanings_to_machine_codes` failed at `explain_remaining.rs:213` on `T91 (TOOL 91)` | Passed |

These were temporary local mutations. No source edit remains.

**Heavy lanes run by this review**

The PR body has no heavy results. I ran every selected test lane locally with `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --only 'app heavy'`.
The selector omits the broad build step. Each selected command builds its own release test target.
All 17 steps passed. The one ignored test ran and passed in `lathe_workholding_kinds`.
The other selected targets contain no ignored tests.
